segments.name: Building Products
segments.description: Provides pressurized containment solutions, HVAC systems, metal roofing clips and, through joint ventures, ceiling suspension systems and light gauge metal framing for construction customers.
segments.evidence: Our Building Products business is a market-leading provider of critical components in essential categories, including: (i) pressurized containment solutions for heating, cooking, cooling and water applications; (ii) HVAC systems; (iii) metal roofing clips; and (iv), through our unconsolidated joint ventures, WAVE and ClarkDietrich, ceiling suspension systems and light gauge metal framing products.

segments.name: Consumer Products
segments.description: Designs and manufactures products sold to consumers, primarily through retail channels, in the tools, outdoor living and celebrations market categories.
segments.evidence: Our business is managed and reported under two operating segments that are distinguishable by the nature of the products and services provided: Building Products and Consumer Products.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net sales from selling manufactured products to retail customers, gas producers and distributors, and construction market customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Sales to one retail customer accounted for 10% of our consolidated net sales in fiscal 2026.

changes.text: In fiscal 2024, the company completed the separation of its steel processing business into Worthington Steel and changed its name to Worthington Enterprises.
changes.evidence: On December 1, 2023, we completed the Separation of our former steel processing business into a separate public company in a transaction intended to qualify as tax free to our shareholders, which was accomplished via the Distribution.

changes.text: In fiscal 2024, the company deconsolidated its former Sustainable Energy Solutions operating segment.
changes.evidence: We recognized non-cash charges of $50,050 in fiscal 2025 related to the write-down of intangible assets associated with GTI and $32,203 in fiscal 2024 due to the deconsolidation of our former Sustainable Energy Solutions operating segment.
